description: Buys one use of one photo from this account's prepaid photo wallet and returns the license and a download link to the file (metadata removed). max_price_cents is the most the operator agreed to pay; a higher current price is refused with the quote and nothing is charged. Re-sending the same idempotency_key returns the same license instead of buying again. Spending is capped per UTC day. While NUM's licensing is in its test run, purchases use test credit and no money moves; the response says test: true.

idempotency_key.description: Your own key for this purchase; a retry with the same key never buys twice.

max_price_cents.description: The most the operator agreed to pay for this use, in US cents.

name: num_license_photo
title: License one use of a photo
